Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 117. Category: heroic. Heroic Features.

Once per long rest when you see a Technique that you
are capable of learning you may memorize it. Until you
change this move you may replicate it without gaining
your proficiency bonus. This move remains memorized
until you replace it with a different move. If you learn
the move that you have memorized it instantly gains 1
star.
